Record Class TestSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.dev.manifest.TestSettings
Record Components:
runner - The identifier of the test runner, junit-platform by default
affectedOnly - Whether a change runs only the tests it can affect, rather than every test
initialRun - Whether every test runs once when the runtime starts
once - Whether the runtime runs the tests once and stops, for a build that wants the result
reports - Where the JUnit XML reports go
patterns - The --tests patterns every run is filtered by
parameters - The runner's configuration parameters
public record TestSettings(String runner, boolean affectedOnly, boolean initialRun, boolean once, Path reports, List<String> patterns, Map<String,String> parameters) extends Record
How test mode runs the tests.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
